title: The thirds étude, then and now
work: Étude in G♯ minor, Op. 25 No. 6
question: How do Paderewski and Neeman place surges and withdrawals inside the same two-minute étude?
intro: Paderewski’s Victor 917-B comes from a Camden session on 4 May 1923; Neeman’s recording was released through Musopen’s Set Chopin Free project. Both access files last about 2:10, but this does not mean that corresponding phrases occupy identical spans. The alignment excludes the terminal transfer tails and keeps the older recording’s surface noise distinct from piano articulation.
